s1.syndrome_frame: Jaundice and upper abdominal pain with pancreatic involvement
salient_findings: Jaundice
Epigastric tenderness
Diffusely enlarged pancreas with delayed enhancement on CT
Intrahepatic bile-duct dilation
Diffuse pancreatic enlargement with low T1 signal on MRI
Stenosis of the lower bile duct and diffuse narrowing of the main pancreatic duct on ERCP
key_facts: Normal serum IgG4 and amylase levels

raw.syndrome_frame: Jaundice and upper abdominal pain with pancreatic involvement
salient_findings: Jaundice
Epigastric tenderness

differentials: Pancreatic metastasis from other primary sites
Gastrointestinal stromal tumor of the pancreas
Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with cystic degeneration
Solid pseudopapillary neoplasm with aggressive features
Pancreatic metastasis from renal cell carcinoma

shortlist.label: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse pancreatic enlargement, delayed enhancement, and high diffusion-weighted imaging signal on MRI, along with elevated CA19-9 level and jaundice

shortlist.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse pancreatic enlargement and capsule-like rim on CT, normal serum IgG4 levels, but clinical presentation and imaging findings are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Chronic pancreatitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of abdominal pain, elevated hepatobiliary enzymes, and pancreatic duct narrowing on ERCP

shortlist.label: Pancreatic cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated carcinoembryonic antigen and CA19-9 levels, jaundice, and epigastric tenderness

shortlist.label: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Intrahepatic bile-duct dilation and pancreatic duct narrowing on ERCP, which could be associated with this condition

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with jaundice, epigastric tenderness, elevated bilirubin, and elevated tumor markers (CEA and CA19-9) along with imaging findings of a diffusely enlarged pancreas and bile duct stenosis are highly suggestive of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Autoimmune pancreatitis
rejected.why: Normal serum IgG4 levels make this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Chronic pancreatitis
rejected.why: The presence of significant jaundice and elevated tumor markers are not typical for chronic pancreatitis

rejected.label: Pancreatic cancer
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, but the specific diagnosis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is more precise based on the provided information

rejected.label: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
rejected.why: The imaging findings and tumor marker elevations are more consistent with an invasive cancer like pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma rather than an intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
